keys.fallback: What pattern do the breast feathers make?
Follow the fine dark bars across this adult peregrine’s pale underparts. Compare their direction with the streaks on a red-tailed hawk. Keep a view and describe the pattern you can see.
Find the pale throat patch, then follow the darker bars across the lower breast. How do the markings change from one area to the next? Keep a view to record your observation.
Look for the dark streaks gathered into a belly band. Compare their direction with the bars on a peregrine or great horned owl. Keep a view and describe the difference.
Follow the overlapping feathers from the breast toward the tail. Orbit to compare light and dark areas, then keep a view that shows a feature you could use to describe this bird.
